note: Wexford County's zoning districts are shown only in the Schneider Beacon interactive viewer (AppID 1181, LayerID 35111), which exposes no public ArcGIS REST service. The Wexford Joint Planning Commission (covering the county's townships) and the city of Cadillac publish zoning only as PDF maps. No queryable zoning polygon service was found for the county or its cities after searching ArcGIS Hub, ArcGIS Online, the county GIS pages and the LIAA map hosts (ws6/maps.liaa.org, which returned 404s).
